heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2070136:1913.June 1, 1982, Pub. L. 97–192, § 14, 96 Stat. 111. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possessions of the United States”.
